title: Kepimpinan & Pengurusan
canDo: Give constructive feedback to a team member
Motivate and align a team around a goal
Discuss management style and delegation nuance
lifeBenefit: Lead and manage people in Malay with the nuance a real workplace requires.

vocab.example: Saya nak beri maklum balas membina, bukan kritikan.
vocab.exampleEn: I want to give constructive feedback, not criticism.

vocab.example: Saya perlu mendelegasikan tugas ini dengan lebih baik.
vocab.exampleEn: I need to delegate this task better.

vocab.example: Bagaimana saya boleh memotivasikan pasukan yang letih?
vocab.exampleEn: How can I motivate a tired team?

vocab.example: Setiap ahli pasukan perlu ada akauntabiliti.
Kita perlu bincang pasal prestasi tidak memuaskan awak.
vocab.exampleEn: We need to discuss your unsatisfactory performance.

vocab.example: Sebagai pemimpin, saya cuba membina keyakinan pasukan.
vocab.exampleEn: As a leader, I try to build the team's confidence.

vocab.example: Kita perlukan visi strategik yang jelas.
vocab.exampleEn: We need a clear strategic vision.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'I want to delegate this and give constructive feedback later.'
practiceExercises.answer: Saya nak mendelegasikan ini dan beri maklum balas membina kemudian.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'Every team member needs accountability to stay motivated.'
practiceExercises.answer: Setiap ahli pasukan perlu ada akauntabiliti untuk kekal bermotivasi.

scenario.setting: A manager having a difficult performance conversation with an underperforming team member

script.ms: Saya nak bincang pasal prestasi awak akhir-akhir ini.
script.en: I want to discuss your performance recently.

script.ms: Baik. Saya tahu ada beberapa kelewatan.
script.en: Alright. I know there have been some delays.

script.ms: Saya bagi maklum balas membina — bukan untuk salahkan, tapi untuk bantu awak.
script.en: I'm giving constructive feedback — not to blame, but to help you.

script.ms: Terima kasih. Apa yang perlu saya perbaiki?
script.en: Thank you. What do I need to improve?

script.ms: Mari kita bina semula keyakinan dan bincang cara mendelegasikan tugas dengan lebih baik.
script.en: Let's rebuild confidence and discuss how to delegate tasks better.

scenario.aiPrompt: You are a manager giving difficult but constructive feedback to a team member about performance issues. Stay calm, empathetic, and solution-focused throughout. Standard, professional managerial register.

speakingPrompts.instructions: Shadow the difficult-conversation dialogue, focusing on calm, empathetic managerial tone.
Have a difficult performance conversation with the AI team-member persona, giving constructive feedback and a next step.
Give a 3-minute talk on your leadership philosophy or approach to managing a team.
